query: query HereIsItContainerUsageV1($accountTag: String, $datetimeStart: Time, $datetimeEnd: Time, $applicationId: String, $instanceId: String) { viewer { accounts(filter: { accountTag: $accountTag }) { containersUsageAdaptiveGroups(limit: 2 filter: { datetime_geq: $datetimeStart datetime_lt: $datetimeEnd applicationId: $applicationId instanceId: $instanceId } orderBy: [datetimeHour_ASC]) { dimensions { datetimeHour applicationId instanceId } sum { cpuTimeSec allocatedMemory allocatedDisk txBytes } } } } }
